name: Fatigue
description: Persistent low energy not relieved by sleep.

name: Muscle cramps
description: Painful involuntary muscle contractions, especially at night or post-exercise.

name: Hair thinning or shedding
description: Diffuse hair loss not from a defined medical cause.

name: Low mood
description: Persistent mild depressive feelings without major depression diagnosis.

name: Frequent colds / infections
description: More than 4 minor infections per year.

name: Slow wound healing
description: Cuts and scrapes that take longer than usual to close.

name: Cold intolerance
description: Feeling cold easily, especially hands and feet.

name: Bone density concerns
description: Osteopenia / osteoporosis risk or family history.
